paper_title: PM-KVQ Progressive Mixed-precision KV Cache Quantization for Long-CoT   LLMs
caption: : DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-70B

model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates per-layer (per “block”) sensitivity values for the model “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-70B,” with bars colored by two quantization settings indicated in the legend (blue = “4-Fbit,” green = “2-Fbit”). The horizontal axis contains the categories as sequential “Block Index” values progressing left to right, with labeled ticks at 0, 19, 39, 59, and 79 and evenly spaced bars for each index. The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Sensitivity” and is shown on a logarithmic scale with major tick labels at approximately \(10^{-6}\), \(10^{-5}\), and \(10^{-4}\); the visible bar heights span roughly from a few \(10^{-7}\) up to slightly above \(10^{-4}\). Most blocks from the beginning through the high-50s are shown as green (2-Fbit) bars, with values typically around \(10^{-6}\) to several \(\times 10^{-6}\), including some early bars near roughly \(3\text{–}5\times10^{-6}\) and some lower green bars dipping to around \(3\text{–}6\times10^{-7}\); around the mid-40s there is a short segment of blue (4-Fbit) bars reaching on the order of several \(\times 10^{-6}\) (near the \(10^{-5}\) gridline but below it). From approximately block index 59 to the end of the axis, the bars are predominantly blue (4-Fbit) and rise into the \(10^{-5}\) to \(10^{-4}\) range, with early bars in this region around \(1\text{–}2\times10^{-5}\) and the final bars near index ~79 reaching close to or slightly above \(10^{-4}\) (approximately \(1\text{–}2\times10^{-4}\)). The bars are presented in increasing block-index order (not alphabetically), and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines, annotations, or error bars beyond the color coding and the dashed horizontal gridlines.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates per-block “Sensitivity” values across transformer blocks for the model (captioned DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-70B), with bars colored by a two-level precision designation shown in the legend (blue = “4-Fbit”, green = “2-Fbit”). The horizontal axis contains the categories as “Block Index”, running from 0 to 79 with labeled ticks at 0, 19, 39, 59, and 79, and the bars are placed at successive integer indices. The vertical axis is labeled “Sensitivity” and uses a logarithmic scale, with major tick labels shown at approximately \(10^{-6}\), \(10^{-5}\), and \(10^{-4}\), and the plotted values spanning from below \(10^{-6}\) up to slightly above \(10^{-4}\). Most bars from early indices are green (2-Fbit), with heights generally around the \(10^{-6}\) decade (e.g., several near \(\sim 1\times10^{-6}\) to \(\sim 5\times10^{-6}\)), and a few dipping below \(10^{-6}\) (down to a few \(\times 10^{-7}\)); around the mid-40s to high-50s there is a mix where some blue (4-Fbit) bars appear among green bars, with blue heights in this region around several \(\times 10^{-6}\) (near the lower end of the \(10^{-5}\) decade). From roughly block index 59 through 79, the bars are predominantly blue (4-Fbit) and rise into and within the \(10^{-5}\) decade, with later blocks reaching near \(10^{-4}\) and the tallest bar at the far right slightly above \(10^{-4}\) (around \(\sim 1\text{–}2\times10^{-4}\)). The bars are not presented as stacked or grouped within each index (each index shows a single bar with a single color), and there are no additional visual emphasis elements such as outlines, annotations, or explicit sorting beyond the natural increasing order of block indices.
